rulings.topic: Run C-8 — the EoR Warlord (pixel-overworld regime): founding rulings
rulings.ruling: Matt 2026-09-20: finish the EoR Warlord across all directions. W1 idle = RESTING idle only (no second idle for now). W2 attack = the Eye of Reckoning SPIN, looping, and attach the EoR whirlwind VFX already built in the Godot 3D work — the spin rate of the attack clip must match that VFX. W3 cast = shield-forward slam/thrust, projectile from the mace head (the socket). W4 resting idle as the Keeper had (at ease, breath). W5 include run. W6 order: walk + run first, then attack, then cast, then jump (conductor slots the resting idle after run). Seeds: 5 Grok stills from one reference (S r1; SW, E, NE, N) — probe-grade seeds promoted to this lap seeds; W/SW-mirror… mirrors W←E, SE←SW, NW←NE (F17a). Register: a LAP DECISION in the pixel-overworld regime — recognition record owed; style-register.md stays locked pending canon. Grok budget: ~35 clips at 5 unique × 7; weekly cap = the HALT. Astra: still dark (T25) — exporter states beyond idle/walk/run/jump/cast (the attack state) need a TOOLING extension when Codex returns; attack cells are staged meanwhile.

images_cap_note: SENTINEL — no image cap; Grok weekly allowance is the constraint (F7 posture carried from C-6)

notes.note: Attack (EoR spin) rate taken from the Godot 3D whirlwind VFX (reincarnated-godot/scripts/wwcr_whirlwind.gd, drax S2 clean-room mint 2026-08-24): OMEGA_DEG = 900 deg/s = 2.5 rev/s (period 0.40 s), SPIN_UP_S 0.70, SPIN_DOWN_S 0.80 — AUTHORED, not measured (mint note § 4.2: cadence absent corpus-wide; measurement aliased). Prompt: 2.5 full revolutions per second, one turn every 0.4 s, ~15 turns per 6-s clip, constant (no wind-up/down in the loop clip). Loop arithmetic for the future attack state: one revolution = 0.40 s = 8 frames at the exporter cast rate (20 fps) → the cut should target an 8-frame cycle at fps-out 20 (or 4 at 10); the wind-up/down live in the VFX (SPIN_UP/DOWN), not in the sprite loop.
